_description: Lesion-Level Semantic Explainability configuration for RetinaGuard. All thresholds and weights are loaded from this file. No magic numbers in code.

attention._threshold_note: Grad-CAM++ map values above this are treated as high-attention regions. Should be tuned on a validation split.
attention._pointing_game_note: Distance tolerance for pointing-game accuracy: peak attention is a 'hit' if within this many pixels of any lesion bounding box.
attention._border_note: If >40% of total attention mass falls in the outer 10% of image border pixels, a BORDER_ATTENTION_SHORTCUT warning is raised.

lesion_separation._ma_note: Connected components with pixel area <= this value are classified as microaneurysm candidates; larger ones as hemorrhage candidates.
lesion_separation._exudate_note: Minimum connected component area to count as an exudate candidate (noise filter).

grounding_weights._note: Weights for the weighted Lesion Grounding Score. Must sum to 1.0.

safety_warnings._hclg_note: If prediction confidence > high_confidence_threshold AND grounding score < low_grounding_threshold, raise HIGH_CONFIDENCE_LOW_GROUNDING.
safety_warnings._min_note: If total detected lesions across all classes < this, raise NO_LESION_CANDIDATES and return Insufficient score.

coverage_fallback._note: For tiny lesions (microaneurysms < 50px area), use distance-to-lesion instead of IoU which is unreliable at small scales.

source_disclaimer: Lesion masks are generated by classical Digital Image Processing algorithms (Black Top-Hat transform and CIE LAB thresholding). They are algorithmic candidates only and have not been validated against expert annotations. The Lesion Grounding Score is a research metric and does not constitute clinical validation.
limitations: Grad-CAM++ is spatially coarse; microaneurysm localization accuracy is limited.
Classical DIP lesion detection is sensitive to image quality and preprocessing.
No expert-annotated ground truth masks are available in this installation.
Scores should not be interpreted as probability of correct diagnosis.
This pipeline is for research and educational purposes only.
